delay.$description: How long a faked read and a faked run take (the runtime's SIMULATED_DELAY): long enough to see a loading state.

reply.$description: The replay of an AI reply as a process (D-45): the scripted runtime and the onboarding interview wait these long, ChatMessageList writes a text out over `write`.

beat.$description: One beat of the AI's work: the thinking state before anything shows, and each step it takes.

write.$description: How long a piece of reply text takes to be written out, whatever its length.

settle.$description: The pause between a whole text and each thing it carries: the table, then the proposal.
